Site Analyzer

Check a website's Domain Authority, then scan it for its strongest pages, content keywords, risks and what to fix.

Scanning…

What you get

  • Page checks for content, technical setup, links and images
  • Page Authority (PA) of your strongest pages, ranked by your own internal linking
  • Content keywords the site really talks about
  • Spam score for patterns that look low quality or spammy
  • Fix list: broken pages, titles, headings, alt text and more
  • Changes since your previous scan: new and lost pages and links
DA, PA and Spam Score are calculated by LinkLens (DA from Common Crawl's web data). Other tools use their own data and formulas, so their numbers differ.
